name: qz-console
description: QualiZeal console: a live map beside the chat of the AI-DLC harness at work - lanes, agents, policy guard, human gates, Knowledge Fabric, GitHub, Jira, bid and demo tools - with the run's lane, stage and token budget

theme.title: Colours
theme.description: Dark, light, or auto (dark on a dark surface, light on a light one).

showRules.title: Show guard rule names
showRules.description: Show which guard rule blocked or asked (for example QZ-SH-ENV-CREDS). The rule's message is never shown: it may quote what the guard found.

coreName.title: Name at the centre
coreName.description: What the circle in the middle says, up to six characters.
